caption:
Sometimes plugging in the choices beats solving.

x² − 5x − 14 = 0. Plug in 2: −20, no. Plug in −2: 0, yes. Answer found without factoring. If the arithmetic gets ugly, Desmos can do it.

Comment if you'd have factored this one.
